title: Combos, Lists and Search
summary: Mesh and texture pickers with Combo and BeginCombo, enum combos, list boxes synced with the selection, ImGuiTextFilter search and ImGuiListClipper for 10,000 assets.

options: Writes true into it when clicked
Only uses it to decide whether to draw the row highlighted; you update your own selection when it returns true
Nothing, it is ignored inside list boxes
quiz.explain: The bool overload is read-only. Your code owns the selection, e.g. if (Selectable(name, gSelectedEntity == i)) gSelectedEntity = i;

quiz.q: Why call SetItemDefaultFocus() on the currently selected item inside BeginCombo?
options: So the popup opens scrolled to that item and keyboard navigation starts there
It is required or EndCombo asserts
quiz.explain: It marks the default nav focus for the window that just appeared, which also scrolls it into view.

quiz.q: You use ImGuiListClipper on 10,000 assets with a search filter. Where should the filtering happen?
options: Inside the clipper loop, with continue on non-matching rows
Build an array of matching indices when the filter changes, and clip over that array
Filtering is impossible with a clipper
quiz.explain: The clipper maps visible rows to indices 0..count-1 and assumes every row is submitted with the same height. Skipping rows inside the loop breaks the scroll math.
